name: nginx-simple
manifest:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx-simple
  labels:
    app: nginx-simple
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: nginx-simple
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nginx-simple
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.21
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 256Mi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: nginx-simple-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: nginx-simple
  ports:
  - protocol: TCP
    port: 80
    targetPort: 80
  type: ClusterIP
